snippet.title: Longplay: De Schippers van de Kameleon (2003) - 4K/60
snippet.description:
This is a promotional game for the movie De Schippers van de Kameleon, which is based on the bookseries De Kameleon written by Hotze de Roos. It came on a 80mm CD-ROM under the lid of a large jar of Calvé pindakaas, a popular pindakaas brand in the Netherlands.

The game is a modified version of Grachtenracer, a boat-racing game developed by Lost Boys Interactive. In this modified version the characters are replaced by the ones in the movie, and you're racing in Friesland, the same location as in the movie.

The disc also contains a trailer for the movie, and old commercials promoting Calvé pindakaas.

System requirements:
Windows 95/98/2000, Pentium II, 32 MB RAM, 50 MB hard disk, 16 bit GPU + 3D acceleration

Download link:
https://bit.ly/dekameleonracer

Did you know that Davilex made more 'Powerboat' / 'Speedboat' games like Grachtenracer, and Miami Speedboat Racer? Check them all out in this playlist:
https://youtube.com/playlist?list=PLZOK8A4t81FPSSEnozSi5AfntJveQYHd2
